summary.text: Karen Toles is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 25, appointed in January 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is an executive and attorney.

paragraphs.text: Toles earned a bachelor's degree in public health from the University of Maryland, College Park in 2000 and a law degree from the University of Baltimore School of Law.

Her career experience includes serving as president of Paramount Policy Partners, as director of community affairs and a legislative advisor with the Prince George's County Office of State's Attorney, and as a political and legislative coordinator and organizer with AFSCME Maryland Council 67.
Gov. Larry Hogan appointed her to the House of Delegates on January 11, 2022, to replace Dereck Davis.
For 2025-2026 she is assigned to the Fair Practices and State Personnel Oversight Committee and the Judiciary Committee.
